insight: Jakiro trades well with popular offlaners due to Dual Breath's attack and move slow. Pair with carries like Ursa for strong lane synergy and kill potential.
Max Liquid Fire and Liquid Frost first. Liquid Fire was nerfed to 75 damage at level one, but Liquid Frost remains strong at level two with Twin Terror facet.
Jakiro has negative pub win rate despite pro success. Poor mana management from casual players and dispel-heavy pub lineups (Rubick, Oracle, Abaddon) contribute to lower performance.
Go 1-1-4 leveling. Start with Nature's Guise into Living Armor for defense, or Leech Seed into Living Armor for aggression. Max Living Armor to 420 damage barrier at level 7.
Rush Aghanim's Shard for map vision. Eyes in the Forest provide global pressure without committing to side lanes. Pros use this to create uncertainty about team positioning.
Use QE max build for split-pushing and map pressure rather than fighting directly. Leech Seed is difficult to use in fights due to long cooldown, so prioritize pickoffs and objective control.
Tusk works best with ranged carries like Gyrocopter and Shadow Fiend. Snowball utility and tag team/Drinking Buddies provide flexible positioning tools.
Prioritize Hellbear Smasher over Sader Mind Stealer since Mind Stealer nerfs made it weaker. Hellbear upgrades at level 5 for AoE farming, while Mind Stealer upgrades at level 7.

Start Penitence and Hellbear creep together for synergy. Penitence gives attack speed buff to everything hitting the creep, improving early lane damage. Adjust with Divine Favor based on carry matchup.
Shadow Demon is better as position four. Position five Shadow Demon lacks the roaming potential and valuable double stacks that position four provides, limiting lane control and map impact.

Spam Shadow Word on carry and Fatal Bonds the creep wave to damage enemies. Hit level 6 fast for grimoire golem to take early objectives. You don't need full team involvement—one kill plus tower damage justifies early ultimate.
Use expanded armature to deforest trees and limit Treant's mobility and ability usage. This denies enemies the need to buy Quelling Blades or pick specific cores.
Play aggressive with ranged carries like Clinkz and Gyrocopter. Use Power Cogs to trap enemies while your carry attacks. Rocket Flare into Hookshot setup for utility and kill potential.
Pick Disruptor later in draft when you know enemies have heroes like Brewmaster, high-mobility cores, or Centaur. Static Storm counters these but he struggles if picked early without clear targets.
Glacial Guard barrier pairs well with armor items. Increased armor from items amplifies the physical barrier. Mana Aura helps carries like Clinkz and Spirit Heroes sustain ability spam.
Use Frostbite as a disarm against right-clicking heroes like Treant and Tusk. Root provides lockdown against Timber Chain, Fast Learner, and Stampede initiators.
Take Chicken Fingers facet and use it with Shackle for early kills on carries like Ursa and Clinkz. Mega Serpent Ward damage nerf makes regular wards with reduced cooldown more viable.
Use ultimate to push tempo and take objectives. When teammates AFK jungle, use serpent wards to push waves and towers. Provides all the crowd control team needs if others pick damage dealers.
Players don't correctly play around Poison Touch in pubs. You can punish harder than pros do. Grave save is valuable in any game since position five doesn't get prioritized in most pubs.
Stay in lane to absorb creeps and convert deaths into mana. Use this mana for sustained blast damage. Prioritize being present over pulling since you need creep absorption for economy.
Max Maledict and Cask first. Maledict is effective against tanky offlaners like Centaur, Legion Commander, and Tidehunter. Take Malpractice facet to bounce Maledict to multiple targets.
Use Maledict plus attack to wear down tanky offlaners. May not kill them in first Maledict rotation, but damage adds up. This matchup advantage separates Witch Doctor from softer supports.
Cold Embrace provides the best healing in lane due to percentage-based healing. Downside is grief potential when teammates can't move/attack. Use safely by backing off or healing yourself early.
Ultimate is one of the best punishers for clumped enemy teams. Exploit poor positioning in pubs where enemies group naturally. Healing plus damage makes you valuable despite weak laning stage.
Oracle has surprising burst damage despite being a healer. Combo Fate's Edict with damage at level 4+. Use this to punish opponents early, not just for saves.
Undying beats many strength-based offlaners with good early game. Tombstone lasts longer than intended in pubs due to player mistakes. Scaling is better now with offlane Undying being viable.
Don't rush Aghanim's early. Play actual support items first, but eventually buy Aghanim's for second-life mechanic. Swap utility remains strong throughout game even without damage items.

People misunderstand Phoenix. Win trades with Fire Spirits frequently. Sunray is particularly strong against tanky cores now—heal tanky teammates with percent HP healing while damaging enemy tanks with percent HP damage.
Venomancer is squishy and can be punished early. Lower ranks get scared by initial poison damage and don't capitalize. Higher ranks target the squishiness before plague wards scale.

Use plague wards for vision and damage in fights while maintaining flexible itemization. Poison Sting scales into late game. Carries like Ursa and popular melee heroes struggle against slows and wards.
Dark Willow scales well and can solo kill with Bedlam. Better as position four, but can work position five with sufficient farm priority and game understanding.
Enemies don't target Omnilight correctly despite his importance. Repel and Guardian Angel cooldowns reduced, improving support viability. Base armor buff (+1) helps survivability.
High-win-rate pub supports punish poor target priority and positioning. Supports that don't get targeted or save out-of-position teammates are strongest in low-rank games.

Healing meta exists due to Guardian Greaves buffs, Holy Locket buffs, and more Eul's purchases—not tango changes. Cores unwilling to buy tangos forces supports to heal, but many top healers already had high win rates pre-patch.

C-tier supports have lower pub win rates due to execution difficulty, not inherent weakness. Tusk combos, Marcy pickups, Grimstroke coordination require team understanding. These heroes are pro-viable but underperform in pubs.

Pick supports that exploit common mistakes: poor positioning, clumping, lack of targeting focus, and bad positioning trades. These mechanics separate high-win-rate pub supports from conditional picks.
